extended_feature_contract: fixed 13 condition aptitude + fixed 29 relative/trend/missingness/support; jockey and trainer support included
history_scope: all quality-eligible JRA flat results since 2013; history date strictly before target date; same-day results excluded
base46: raw47 except safe_past5_top3_rate; no outcome-based feature selection in this experiment
learner: identical deterministic CPU LightGBM binary market-logit-offset residual, 150 rounds, runner-weighted objective; not multinomial training

calibration.boundary_policy: warning only; never remove cohort or select another formula

temperature_only: CAL-only T in [0.5,2]; diagnostic, not another ROI-selection candidate
odds_band_scope: left-inclusive right-exclusive; CAL fit is continuous market conditioned; bands and selected-ticket diagnostics never refitted on SELECT or TEST
selection_objective: highest simultaneous bootstrap ROI lower bound on SELECT only; no_bet if lower bound <=100
bootstrap_unit: paired whole race dates stratified by year including no-bet dates
simultaneous_ci_method: Bonferroni 19 policy family; report finite extreme-tail Monte Carlo resolution
primary_probability_metrics: matched bootstrap95 delta NLL/Brier vs market
rmse_scope: not a speed regression experiment; do not label probability RMSE as speed RMSE
odds_role: historical saved final results odds; unverified executable pre-start timing; ROI is retrospective proxy
payout_source: saved_netkeiba_result_return_table; actual single-winner payout; never odds substituted
